Spicy Brazilian-style coconut chicken with tender chicken thighs, creamy coconut sauce, and a hint of lime and cilantro. Comfort food with a tropical twist🥥 I hope you’ll give it a try ❤️ Ingredients (2-3 person) For the Spicy Coconut Chicken •	14 oz/400 g chicken thighs, boneless  •	Salt and freshly cracked black pepper •	Juice of ½ lime •	1 tsp paprika •	chili flakes (adjust to taste) •	0,5 tsp cayenne (adjust to taste) •	olive oil For the Sauce •	1 small onion, chopped •	3 garlic cloves, minced •	1 red bell pepper, sliced •	2 medium sized tomato  chopped  •	1 tbsp tomato paste •	1 can coconut milk / 400 ml / 13.5 oz •	½ tsp turmeric •	1 tsp paprika or smoked paprika for a more smookey flavor  •	0,5 tsp cumin  To Serve •	White or coconut rice •	Lime wedges for garnish •	fresh cilantro, chopped  •	Optional: fresh red chili, for extra heat Instructions 1.	Season the chicken: Mix chicken with lime juice, salt, pepper, paprika, chili flakes, cayenne (optional), and olive oil. Let sit 10-15 min. 2.	Sear the chicken: Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken thighs and sear 6-8 min per side until golden. Remove and set aside. 3.	Build the sauce: In the same pan, sauté onion until soft (3-4 min). Add garlic and cook 30 sec. Stir in bell pepper, tomato, tomato paste, and spices, cooking 2-3 min until fragrant. 4.	Add coconut milk: Pour in the full can, stir, and bring to a gentle simmer. Cook a few min until slightly thickened. 5.	Finish the chicken: Return chicken to pan. Simmer 5-10 min or until fully cooked and sauce is creamy. Stir in cilantro. Taste and adjust seasoning or spice. 6.	Serve: Plate chicken with sauce over a generous portion of rice. Garnish with extra cilantro and lime wedges. Enjoy every bite 🫶 #dinnerinspo #easyrecipe #mealinspo #dinnerideas#CapCut

videos.caption: Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Crockpot Parmesan Garlic Chicken & Potatoes are an easy weeknight dinner!  INGREDIENTS 1 lb chicken breasts 1 bag baby potatoes, quartered (or 4-5 russet potatoes cut into cubes)  olive oil + salt, pepper, garlic powder, smoked paprika (for potatoes) 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper 1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning  1 tbsp minced garlic  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic Sauce (just enough to cover chicken) 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese Dried parsley Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Quarter one bag of baby potatoes and cut chicken into cubes. Spray a crockpot with cooking spray.  Add potatoes the crockpot. Season with olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, and smoked paprika (I don’t use exact measurements for this part). Add minced garlic and stir potatoes and seasonings well.  Add the chicken on top of the potatoes. Season chicken with 1/2 tsp each of salt and pepper, 1 tsp each of smoked paprika, onion powder, and Italian seasoning.  Add some garlic Parmesan sauce. I use just enough of the sauce to cover the chicken. You can always add more sauce if needed once everything is cooked.  Cook on low for about 6 hours or until potatoes are cooked to your liking. Stir everything well.  Top with shredded mozzarella cheese and let it sit just until the cheese is melted.  Top with some dried parsley and Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #easyrecipes #dinner #crockpot

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Tender stewed chicken and gravy recipe: Cook time: 80-90 mins  Servings: 6 Ingredients:  1/2 yellow onion  1/2 green bell pepper  1/2 red bell pepper  4 crushed garlic cloves  1/2 stick butter or olive oil  2 TBSP All purpose flour   6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs  4 cups of chicken broth  Dried parsley  Seasonings: all purpose seasoning (such as natures seasoning or lawrys) onion & garlic powders, paprika, Italian seasoning, black pepper and if you don’t mind some spice toss in some Slap ya mama.  Directions: Season about 6-8 boneless skinless chicken thighs (depending on how many you’re serving) with all named seasonings. Marinate from 1 hour up to overnight. The longer the better. Use a Dutch oven or stock pot to sear the chicken in 2 TBSP of butter or olive oil. Sear for about 2-3 mins on each side on a medium high heat.  Remove chicken from pot. If you see little dark bits and pieces at the bottom of the pot leave it. It’s not burnt. That’s flavor that you want to keep in your pot to make the meal even more flavorful. It will deglaze and cook into the stew once you add your chicken broth.  In the same pot (without washing) on a medium heat add 1-2 TBSP of butter (depending on how much oil or butter you have left from searing the chicken). Add your peppers, onions and seasonings and cook down your peppers and onions for about 8-10 mins or until tender.  Once tender while still on a medium heat add in 1 TBSP of butter and whisk in 2 tbsp of flour to make a roux. Whisk frequently. Don’t walk away from your roux because this is A quick roux and can burn easily so watch it closely.  After about 5 mins you should have the color roux you want your gravy to be. For example if you want a dark brown gravy that roux should be dark brown.  After you’ve achieved that color add in 3 cups of chicken broth 1 cup at a time while stirring in between each cup. Season to taste with named seasonings.  Add in 3-4 crushed garlic cloves and a hefty TBSP of parsley. Put the lid on partially to bring this gravy to a simmer on a medium heat.  After about 10 mins add your chicken in and let it cook on a medium heat for 1 hour. Check it every 10 mins to make sure it doesn’t need more liquid. After your chicken is tender to your preference serve over rice or however you prefer.  **I served mine over white rice with loose, seasoned buttery corn and A blueberry loaf bread I made in the oven using Martha white blueberry cheesecake mix.  Enjoy ♥️

Fall Gameday Comfort Food Series Part 1: Honey Chipotle Fried Chicken Mac & Cheese Recipe👇: Ingredients • Chicken breast • Hot sauce • Pickle juice • Buttermilk • PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning • Potato starch • Flour • Frying oil • Honey chipotle sauce • Butter • Evaporated milk • Whole milk • Heavy cream • Mustard • Cheddar • Gruyère • Mozzarella • Oaxaca • Monterey Jack • Pasta shells • Paprika • Ranch • Parsley Instructions 1. Marinate the chicken in hot sauce, pickle juice, buttermilk and PoggioliEats Cajun Seasoning. 2. Mix 2 parts potato starch with 1 part flour and more Cajun seasoning. Coat the chicken and fry until crispy and cooked through. Toss in honey chipotle sauce. 3. Melt butter, stir in flour and Cajun seasoning, then gradually add evaporated milk, whole milk and heavy cream. Once thickened, stir in hot sauce and mustard. 4. Melt in cheddar, Gruyère, mozzarella, Oaxaca and Monterey Jack. Fold in the cooked shells. 5. Add half the mac and cheese to a baking dish, layer with cheese, then add the rest. Top with cheddar and paprika and bake at 325°F until hot and bubbly. 6. Serve the mac and cheese topped with honey chipotle chicken, ranch and parsley. #chicken #cheese #chipotle #dinner #recipe

GROUND BEEF BULGOGI A quick, savory Korean‑inspired beef bowl that’s perfect for weeknights. INGREDIENTS Main 1 lb ground beef 1 onion, sliced 1 tbsp minced garlic Oil, for cooking Sesame oil, for finishing Sesame seeds, garnish Chopped scallion, garnish Kimchi or radish kimchi, for serving Sauce 2 tbsp brown sugar 2 tbsp mirin 4 tbsp soy sauce (low sodium preferred) 1 tbsp Korean plum syrup* *Sub: 1 tbsp water + 1 tsp apple cider vinegar INSTRUCTIONS 1. Peel and slice the onion; set aside. 2. Combine brown sugar, mirin, soy sauce, and plum syrup (or substitute). Mix well and set aside. 3. Heat a little oil in a pan. Add sliced onions and cook for 1 minute. Add minced garlic and cook for another minute until fragrant. 4. Add ground beef and break it into small pieces. Once the beef is about 30% cooked, pour in the sauce. Let it simmer until the sauce reduces and evaporates — stir occasionally. (This part takes a little time, but it’s worth it.) 5. Drizzle with sesame oil and give it a final mix. 6. Assemble your bowl with rice, scallions, sesame seeds, and kimchi/ veggie of choice. Enjoy!

INGREDIENTS: •20 oz chicken breast, diced •1/3 cup honey •2 tbsp soy sauce •2 tsp minced garlic •20 oz broccoli (Or veggie of choice)  •1 1/4 cups jasmine rice INSTRUCTIONS: 1. Recipe Name Caramel Cream Rice Krispie Treats Ingredients 1. 6 cups crispy rice cereal 2. 4 cups mini marshmallows 3. 4 tbsp unsalted butter 4. 1/2 cup creamy peanut butter 5. 1/2 cup caramel sauce 6. 1 cup white chocolate chips 7. 4 oz cream cheese, softened 8. 1/2 cup powdered sugar 9. 1 tsp vanilla extract 10. 1 cup heavy whipping cream 11. 1/4 cup caramel sauce, for drizzling 12. 1/2 cup crispy rice cereal, for topping Recipe 1. Line a 9×13-inch baking dish with parchment paper and lightly grease it. 2. Melt the butter in a large saucepan over low heat. 3. Add the mini marshmallows and stir continuously until completely melted and smooth. 4. Stir in the peanut butter until fully incorporated. 5. Remove the mixture from the heat and gently fold in the crispy rice cereal. 6. Press half of the cereal mixture firmly into the prepared dish to create an even base. 7. Melt the white chocolate chips gently in the microwave in short intervals, stirring between each interval. 8. Beat the softened cream cheese, powdered sugar, and vanilla until smooth. 9. Whip the heavy cream until soft peaks form, then gently fold it into the cream cheese mixture. 10. Spread the cream mixture evenly over the first cereal layer. 11. Refrigerate for 15–20 minutes to help the creamy layer firm up. 12. Gently press the remaining cereal mixture over the cream layer without crushing it. 13. Warm the caramel sauce slightly and drizzle it generously over the top. 14. Sprinkle additional crispy rice cereal over the caramel. 15. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour until firm enough to slice. 16. Lift the dessert from the pan using the parchment paper and cut into neat squares. 17. Fragrant Golden Yellow Rice - 20g Reduced Fat Butter - 35g Minced Garlic - 200g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 1 Tsp Salt - 250g Uncooked Basmati Rice - 600g Water • Cook garlic and onion on medium low heat for 5-6 mins till softened and fragrant, then add spices and uncooked rice. Check halfway to mix, prevents sticking Special Garlic White Sauce (big batch, store in bottle) - 150g Fat Free Yogurt - 75g Light Mayo - 25g Honey - 1/2 Tsp each Salt & Black Pepper - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 25g Pickle Juice (add to your desired consistency) Fresh Crunchy Slaw (big batch, store separately) - 250g Red Onion, thinly sliced - 300g Cherry Tomatoes, chopped - 200g Pickled Gherkins, thinly sliced - 2 Tbsp Fresh Parsley, chopped - 1 Tsp each Salt & Black Pepper - 1 Tsp Sumac ENJOY! . . . . #shawarma #ricebowl #chickenrecipes #mealprep #healthyrecipes

I take women’s rights seriously, so this is one of the first things I asked about while visiting Ghardaïa, Algeria  Now this is not necessarily for any reason. It has nothing to do with religion or location. The only thing it has to do with is that many communities that are small and follow old traditions typically give less rights and protections to women. However, I was pleasantly surprised that this is not the case in Ghardaia.   I really appreciate what I learned about  Mozabite communities, giving women in their own committees and ability to make decisions for themselves. When it comes to dress, extra protections, to feel safe and comfortable in their marriages, and the community standing in solidarity with its women. ✨ Creamy Garlic Chicken & Mashed Potatoes 🤍🧄🥔 🕒 Total Time: ~35 minutes 🍽️ Serves: 4-6 📋 Ingredients: • 2 lbs chicken breasts, sliced in half lengthwise • 2 tbsp olive oil • 2 tbsp butter • 2 tbsp all-purpose flour • 1½ cups chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream or half-and-half • ½ cup grated parmesan cheese • Garlic salt • Onion powder • Paprika • Black pepper • Mashed potatoes, for serving 👩🏼‍🍳 Directions: 1. Season chicken generously with garlic salt, onion powder, paprika, and black pepper. 2. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. 3. Cook chicken 4-5 minutes per side until golden brown and cooked through. Remove from skillet and set aside. 4. Reduce heat to medium. Add butter to the skillet and let melt. 5. Whisk in flour and cook for 1-2 minutes to create a roux. 6. Slowly pour in chicken broth while whisking until smooth and thickened. 7. Stir in heavy cream (or half-and-half) and parmesan cheese. Simmer until the gravy is rich, creamy, and silky smooth. 8. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over top. Simmer for 3-5 minutes. 9. Serve over warm mashed potatoes and drizzle with plenty of that creamy garlic gravy. ✨ This is the kind of dinner that has everyone asking for seconds and a piece of bread to clean the plate. 🤍 #CreamyGarlicChicken #DinnerAtRileys #ComfortFood #EasyDinnerRecipe #FamilyDinner

STOP BUYING store-bought cookies… make these instead💛 1 recipe✨60 cookies✨3 different flavors✨ The best part? If you break down the exact amount of ingredients used, these cookies cost less than $10 to make. Here’s your next pot luck dish or hostess gift👍 I love making these dairy free so they can easily be served after a meat meal, but you can absolutely use regular butter and dairy fillings if you prefer. Printable recipe and link to all products used, on sivanskitchen.com Prep time: 30 minutes  Bake time: 25-30 minutes  Yields: about 60 cookies  Ingredients: • 3½ cups all purpose flour (500 g) • ¾ tablespoon baking powder (10 g) • ½ cup powdered sugar (75 g), plus more for dusting • 3 sticks non-dairy butter or real butter (340 g)  • ⅓ cup oil (80 mL) • Pinch of salt • Slightly less than ¼ cup water (about 50–55 mL) Water can be substituted with orange juice or milk if making dairy cookies. Fillings: • Plant-based Nutella • Crushed hazelnuts • Date spread • Crumbled halva • Biscoff cookie butter • Crushed Biscoff cookies Instructions: Place all dough ingredients into a mixer or large bowl and combine until a soft, pliable dough forms. If the dough feels too dry, add a little more liquid, 1 tablespoon at a time. If it feels too wet, add a little more flour. The dough is very forgiving. Divide dough into 3 equal pieces. Place dough between 2 sheets of parchment paper and roll into a thin rectangle or oval, about ⅛ inch thick. Spread your filling of choice and add toppings. Using the parchment paper to help guide you, carefully roll the dough into a log, gently peeling back the parchment as you go. Using a knife or bench scraper, cut cookies about ¾ inch thick and transfer onto a parchment-lined baking sheet. I like using a bench scraper to help lift the cookies. Repeat with remaining dough. Bake in a preheated 350°F oven for about 25–30 minutes. Once completely cooled, dust generously with powdered sugar and enjoy. These freeze beautifully. Store in a cookie jar on the counter, in the refrigerator for extra freshness, or freeze the dough ahead of time until needed. #sivanskitchen #cookies #easyrecipe #savemoney #gifting

This has definitely been added to my weekly rotation 🤤 Ingredients Chicken 4-5 chicken thighs 1 tsp black pepper  ¾ tsp salt ½ tsp garlic powder ½ tsp onion powder 1/2 tsp smoked paprika (optional) 1/2 tsp dried thyme (optional) 1 tbsp olive oil Creamy Pepper Sauce 1/2 white onion, very finely chopped 3 garlic cloves minced  2 tbsp crushed peppercorns  1/4 tsp rosemary  150 ml chicken stock 100 ml double cream 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce  1 tbsp butter Salt, to taste Extra crushed black pepper, if needed Parsley chopped  Crispy Baby Potatoes baby potatoes 1–1½ tbsp olive oil Salt Black pepper 1/4 tsp dried thyme  1/4 tsp rosemary 1 tbsp butter 1/2 tsp garlic Method  Potatoes Groove the baby potatoes with a wedge cutter. Boil in salted water for 6–8 minutes, then drain and steam-dry. Toss with oil, salt, pepper and herbs. Air fry at 190°C for 15 minutes, shake, then 200°C for 5–8 minutes. Add butter and crushed garlic for the last 2–3 minutes. Chicken Pat the thighs dry and apply the prepared seasoning. Sear in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes per side, until cooked through. Remove and rest. Pepper Sauce In the same pan, add 1 tbsp butter and finely chopped white onion and garlic. Cook for 2–3 minutes. Add in the crushed peppercorns, add the chicken stock, scrape the pan and simmer for 2–3 minutes. Add the mustard, Worcestershire sauce and rosemary. Stir in the double cream, simmer for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. Return the chicken to the sauce for 1–2 minutes. Sprinkle chopped parsley if using. Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Creamy tomato pasta ✨🍝 a 10-minute meal that hits EVERY time 🤌🏽 Full Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients 200g pasta, dry  250g cherry tomatoes, halved ½ red onion, finely diced 2 garlic cloves, minced 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp tomato purée ½ tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp dried oregano Salt & black pepper, to taste 2 ladles pasta water 1 tbsp cream cheese 30g grated cheese Squeeze of fresh lemon juice Fresh parsley, chopped, to serve Method 1. Cook the pasta according to the packet instructions until al dente. Reserve some pasta water before draining. 2. Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat. Add the red onion and cherry tomatoes and sauté for 4–5 minutes until softened. 3. Add the garlic, smoked paprika, dried oregano, salt and black pepper. Cook for another minute. 4. Stir in the tomato purée, then add 2 ladles of pasta water. Mix well and let the sauce simmer for 2–3 minutes. 5. Add a squeeze of fresh lemon juice, then add the cooked pasta and toss everything together. 6. Stir through the cream cheese until smooth and creamy. 7. Add the grated cheese and fresh parsley mix until melted and combined. Add a splash more pasta water if needed to loosen the sauce.  #EasyRecipes #DinnerIdeas #cookwithme #simpledinner #dinner

LOOK IDENTITY — AETHER NOMAD 9099 🛸🤎🤍🩶 📍 Date officielle de naissance du look : 22.08.9099 Un look imaginé pour une époque où la mode ne cherche plus à suivre le futur… elle vient directement de lui. Le pantalon cargo à double ceinture signé @flyerrer.official conserve l’ADN street des années 90/2000, mais ici, il est propulsé dans une autre dimension. Taille volontairement abaissée, volumes XXL, poches cargo, nuances beige poussière et chocolat : la silhouette semble avoir été retrouvée dans une archive venue de 9099. Cette fois, le haut change complètement l’histoire. La maille zippée à col montant et ses détails effet fourrure construisent une silhouette plus sculpturale, plus mystérieuse, presque extraterrestre. Sa palette claire dialogue parfaitement avec le pantalon et crée un contraste entre douceur, puissance et futurisme. Les deux ceintures deviennent une véritable signature visuelle. Les sneakers massives ancrent le look dans le présent, tandis que les lunettes futuristes et le chapeau que j’ai imaginé transportent l’ensemble bien au-delà de notre époque. 🕶️🛸 Et le plus important ? Je n’ai pas simplement assemblé des vêtements. J’ai construit une identité. La façon de porter chaque pièce, les proportions, les accessoires, les matières et l’attitude ont été pensés pour créer une silhouette que l’on remarque avant même de comprendre pourquoi. Aujourd’hui, les gens tournent la tête. Ils demandent des photos. Ils cherchent à comprendre. En 9099, ils chercheront probablement à comprendre d’où cette archive est arrivée. ⚡️ Conseil de style : Ne cherche pas à porter ce que tout le monde porte. Cherche à créer quelque chose que les autres n’ont encore jamais vu. La mode devient puissante lorsqu’elle ne demande pas : « Est-ce que ça plaît ? » Elle demande : « Est-ce que ça va rester dans leur mémoire ? » Un vrai look ne suit pas l’époque. Il lui donne quelque chose à rattraper. 🛸🤎🤍🩶🕶️ @flyerrer.official 🖤 @_startexceedend_ 🤍 #aethernomad9099

Garlic Herb Grilled Chicken Bowl🍗🧄🍚🥗 Juicy Middle Eastern grilled chicken served with fluffy spicy rice, refreshing tabbouleh, and a smooth, spicy garlic cream sauce. Every bite is loaded with flavour🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 650 Calories | 52g Protein | 59g Carbs | 22g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6) Middle Eastern Chicken - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 4 Tsp Oregano - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Paprika - 3 Tsp Cumin - 30g Honey - 80-100g Tomato Paste  - 1 Lemon Juice  - 30g Olive Oil Golden Herb Rice - 300g Uncooked Basmati Rice (Cook this beforehand) - 20g Light Butter - 100g White Onion, finely chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Turmeric - 1 Tsp Paprika - 1 Tsp Cumin Tabouleh Salad - 3 Cups Parsley, chopped - 300g Tomato, chopped and de-seeded - 150g Green Onion/Scallion, chopped - 15g Olive Oil - Lemon Juice - 1/2 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Sumac - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes Spicy Garlic Sauce - 300g Low Fat Yogurt - 100g Light Mayo - 120g Chilli Garlic Sauce (Lee Kum Kee) - 1 Tsp Paprika  - 1 Tsp Onion Powder - 1/4 Cup Evaporated Milk 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add the Middle Eastern spice mix, honey, tomato paste, lemon juice and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a pan over low heat. Add light butter and chopped onion, cook for 5 mins until softened. Stir in the seasoning and toast for 3-4 mins . Add cooked basmati rice, turn off the heat and mix until fluffy and golden. 3. In a bowl, combine chopped tomato, green onion, parsley, olive oil, seasoning and lemon juice. Mix well and refrigerate until ready to serve. 4. Spread the chicken on a lined sheet pan and oven bake at 200C / 400F for 20-25 mins, then broil/grill for 5 mins until golden and juicy. 5. While the chicken rests, whisk together yogurt, light mayo, chilli garlic sauce, seasonings and evaporated milk until smooth. 6. Serve with the spiced rice, fresh salad and garlic sauce. ENJOY! . . . . #grilledchicken #ricebowl #mealprep #healthyrecipes #chickenrecipes

Crispy Beef Street Corn Tacos 🌽🔥 Ingredients: For the Tacos: -1 lb ground beef -1 packet taco seasoning -2–3 tbsp salsa -1–2 tsp chipotle adobo sauce (adjust to spice preference) -Small flour tortillas -Shredded cheese For the Street Corn Topping: -1/2 cup low-fat cottage cheese -Splash of water (for blending) -1 to 1 1/2 tbsp light mayo -1 cup corn -1–2 jalapeños, finely diced -Chopped pickled red onion -2–3 tbsp cotija cheese -Fresh cilantro, chopped -Everything But The Elote seasoning -Juice of 1 lime For Finishing: -Hot honey -Lime wedges Instructions: 1. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the corn and cook until charred. Remove from heat and let cool. 2. For the Street Corn Mixture: Add cottage cheese and a splash of water to a blender. Blend until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a bowl and mix in: -charred corn -mayo -diced jalapeños -pickled red onion -cotija -cilantro -lime juice -elote seasoning to taste Set aside. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat. Add ground beef and cook until browned. Drain excess grease if needed. Stir in taco seasoning, salsa, and chipotle adobo sauce. Cook for another 2–3 minutes until it’s all absorbed.  4. Place flour tortillas on a baking sheet (spray with oil if needed). Add a layer of shredded cheese, spoon in taco meat, then top with more cheese. Fold each tortilla in half. Place a baking rack on top of the tacos to help keep them closed while baking. Spray with avocado oil.  5. Bake at 425°F for 10–15 minutes, or until golden, crispy, and the cheese is melted. 6. Top warm tacos with the street corn mixture. Finish with a drizzle of hot honey and squeeze of lime. SO GOOD 😮‍💨😮‍💨 #fyp #explorepage✨ #easyrecipe #dinner #healthy

Viral Pepperoni Pizza Caesar Wrap Recipe 🍕 made this wrap for dinner and my family enjoy it! It’s like having a pizza and a Caesar salad together but without the carbs☺️ Makes 2 wraps Ingredients For the Cheese Wraps * 1½ cups freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella cheese * 14–16 pepperoni slices * sprinkle with oregano and red pepper flakes For the Caesar Salad * 1 head romaine lettuce * ¼ cup crushed croutons * Extra parmesan cheese, for topping For the Caesar Dressing * ¼ cup Best Foods mayonnaise * ¼ cup 0% Greek yogurt * Juice from ½ lemon * 2 tsp Worcestershire sauce * 1½ tsp Dijon mustard * 1 large garlic clove, grated * ¼ cup grated parmesan cheese * ¼–½ tsp black pepper Directions 1. Preheat oven to 375°F. 2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper. Spread ¾ cup freshly grated part-skim low-moisture mozzarella into a thin tortilla-sized circle. Top each with 7–8 pepperoni slices and sprinkle with the oregano and red pepper flakes. 3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until crispy around the edges and golden brown. 4. Slice the romaine lettuce lengthwise, chop into thin strips, rinse under cold water, and dry very well using a salad spinner. 5. In a bowl, mix together the mayonnaise, Greek yogurt, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, garlic, parmesan, and black pepper. 6. Toss the romaine with most of the dressing, crushed croutons, and parmesan cheese. 7. Let the wraps cool slightly, then fill with the Caesar salad. Top with extra parmesan, croutons, and dressing if desired. #dinnerideas #easydinners #caesarsalad #pizza #wrap

Creamy Peri Peri Chicken Pasta🍗🧀🍝 Another game changing sheet pan meal prep. This pasta tastes unreal, low effort, easy to make for the week!🤌🏽🔥 Macros Per Serving (8 Total) 592 Calories | 55g Protein | 54g Carbs | 19g Fat Ingredients (Makes 8 Servings) Peri Peri Chicken - 1500g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed - 3 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 Tsp Oregano - 4 Tsp Garlic Powder - 4 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Parsley - 2 Tbsp Freshly Chopped Coriander/Cilantro - 1 Lemon Juiced - 8 Tsp Olive Oil - 100g Nando’s Peri Peri Medium Sauce (used to brush over the chicken before cooking) - Avocado Cooking Spray (4 Tsp worth) Creamy Peri Peri Pasta - 200-250g White & Red Onion, chopped - 200-250g Red & Green Bell Pepper, chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Garlic Powder - 2 Tsp Oregano - 2 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 120-150g Tomato Paste - 180g Light Cream Cheese - 400ml Light Evaporated Milk - 150g Peri Peri Medium Sauce - 480g Uncooked Protein Rigatoni Pasta / ~800-900g Cooked Pasta - Fresh Chopped Parsley 👨‍🍳 Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs. Add seasoning, fresh parsley and coriander, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated and let marinate if time allows. 2. Line a sheet pan and spread the marinated chicken in a single layer. Brush with peri peri sauce and lightly spray with avocado oil. Bake in a preheated oven at 200C / 400F for 22-25 minutes until golden and juicy. While it cooks, boil the pasta, drain, and set aside. 3. Remove the chicken and keep all the pan juices. Add chopped onion and bell pepper, toss in the juices, spread flat, and roast at 180C / 370F for 15 minutes until soft and lightly charred. 4. While pan is hot, add extra seasoning, tomato paste, cream cheese, milk, peri peri sauce. Mix gently until melted creamy - the residual heat will help emulsify sauce. If needed, return to oven for 5 minutes. 5. Stir in cooked pasta and parsley until coated. Slice peri peri chicken, serve over pasta, and ENJOY! . . . #periperichicken #healthyrecipes #pasta #mealprep #sheetpandinner

Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice This Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken & Rice is a cozy, comforting dinner featuring juicy golden chicken served over fluffy rice with a rich, buttery Parmesan garlic sauce. It's simple enough for busy weeknights but delicious enough to feel like a special homemade meal. Ingredients • 1 1/2 pounds chicken tenderloins • 3 cups cooked white rice • 2 tablespoons olive oil • 3 tablespoons butter • 4 cloves garlic, minced • 1 cup chicken broth • 1 cup heavy cream • 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese • 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning • 1/2 teaspoon paprika • 1/2 teaspoon onion powder • Salt and black pepper, to taste • 1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley Instructions Season the chicken with paprika, Italian seasoning, onion powder, salt, and black pepper. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken for 4 to 5 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Transfer to a plate. Reduce the heat to medium and melt the butter in the same skillet. Add the garlic and sauté for about 30 seconds until fragrant. Pour in the chicken broth and stir, scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan. Add the heavy cream and let the sauce simmer gently for 2 to 3 minutes. Whisk in the Parmesan cheese until the sauce is smooth and creamy. Return the chicken to the skillet and spoon the sauce over the top. Simmer for another 2 minutes. Serve the chicken over warm cooked rice and drizzle generously with the creamy garlic butter sauce. Finish with fresh parsley and extra Parmesan if desired. Prep Time: 10 minutes | Cook Time: 25 minutes | Total Time: 35 minutes Servings: 6 | Calories: About 620 per serving #dinner #easyrecipes #chicken #comfortfood #rice

Dolly Parton’s Chicken and Stuffing Casserole  Dolly Parton was not only a great entertainer, she was also a fantastic cook that had so many simple recipes to share. We tried this chicken stuffing casserole of hers and it’s definitely going to be in our fall rotation. It’s simple and delicious and just what we’re looking for this time of year.  #ChickenStuffingCasserole #DollyPartonRecipe • 3 cups cooked chicken shredded or chopped  6 oz stuffing mix any flavor we used savory herb  1 can cream of chicken soup 10 oz 1/2 c sour cream  1 c chicken broth  3 tablespoons melted butter  Salt and pepper to taste  Garlic and onion powder to taste  Mix all ingredients in a large bowl and transfer to a prepared 11 x7 baking dish. Cover and bake at 375 for about 25 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 10-15 minutes until the top is golden.

Marry Me Chicken 🍅✨ A classic dinner idea made a little lighter and packed with protein! This meal is made in one pan and comes together in about 30 minutes. It's the perfect comfort food meal while also helping you hit your protein goals! Makes 4 servings. 4 small chicken breasts (or 2 large cut in half) 1 tbsp olive oil 1 tsp Italian seasoning ½ tsp paprika ½ tsp garlic powder Salt and black pepper, to taste 3 cloves garlic, minced ¾ cup low-sodium chicken broth ⅓ cup chopped sun-dried tomatoes, drained 1 cup low-fat cottage cheese ½ cup fat-free milk ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan cheese 2 cups fresh spinach Fresh basil, for garnish 1. Blend the cottage cheese and fat-free milk until completely smooth and creamy. 2. Season the chicken with the Italian seasoning, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper. 3. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden. Transfer to a plate. 4. Reduce the heat to low-medium and cook the garlic for about 30 seconds until fragrant. 5. Pour in the chicken broth, scraping up any browned bits from the pan. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes and simmer for 2-3 minutes. 6. Remove the skillet from the heat and let cool for about five minutes. 7. Slowly whisk the cottage cheese mixture into the skillet until smooth. (Make sure tomato mixture is cool enough before adding the cottage cheese to prevent curdling!) 8. Add the spinach and cook until wilted. Add Parmesan and mix until melted. 9. Return the chicken to the skillet and warm over low heat for 3-4 minutes. Garnish with fresh basil and enjoy! Serve over pasta, rice, vegetables or bread. #marrymechicken #easydinnerideas #onepanmeal
